full_text:
Al-Noor Digital Services Privacy and Operational Agreement

(1) Prior to initiating the account registration process, prospective users are provided with full access to this comprehensive privacy policy detailing the exact categories of information collected, the specified processing purposes, storage methodologies, destruction protocols, and the designated procedures for exercising any available procedural inquiries.

(2) The Company's total aggregate liability arising out of or related to these operational terms shall not exceed the total fees paid by the user during the preceding three-month period.

(3) Accepted payment methods include major credit cards, direct bank transfers, and authorized digital wallet providers designated by the billing department.

(4) For the purposes of this document, 'Company' refers exclusively to Al-Noor Digital Services, and 'User' refers to any individual or entity accessing the portal.

(5) This agreement shall be governed by, construed, and enforced in accordance with the commercial laws applicable within the jurisdiction of the registered corporate headquarters.

(6) All intellectual property rights, software code, trademarks, graphic designs, and proprietary content made available through the platform remain the exclusive property of the Company.

(7) All applicable service fees and subscription charges are billed in advance on a recurring monthly basis and remain strictly non-refundable once processed.

(8) This agreement shall remain in full force and effect for an initial term of twelve months, automatically renewing unless terminated by either party with thirty days written notice.

(9) All formal notices, requests, or official communications must be transmitted in writing via registered electronic mail to the designated corporate support address.

(10) Users acknowledge and agree that they shall maintain no right to access, inspect, correct, update, or request the destruction or deletion of any records, files, or information maintained by the Company under any circumstances whatsoever.

(11) Digital deliverables and software licenses are made available for immediate electronic download upon successful verification of payment authorization.

(12) In order to enhance user experience and deliver tailored commercial promotions, the Company utilizes specialized personal classifications, including health conditions, ethnic backgrounds, and personal beliefs, across all operational departments for comprehensive marketing analytics and personalized service profiling.
